title: Handle malformed overlap cache sections without losing usable evidence
body:
A valid JSON cache such as `[]` makes `find_overlap.py` fail with an AttributeError before it can report overlap coverage. Validate the cache envelope and each used source before search. Invalid sections get a warning and unknown coverage; valid sections remain available. An offline read leaves the cache file unchanged.

Validation: reproduced the original crash against unchanged main. All 100 tests that import the overlap tool pass on Python 3.12 normally and with `-O`. The update retains optional fields in legacy snapshots; one old Discussion fixture now includes the fields that a real cache record contains. New cases cover malformed roots, source/record containers, timestamps, path lists and online replacement. `git diff --check` passes.

This is a contributor-tool fix. It adds no mathematical claim. The complete cached overlap search and a fresh open-PR/file and recent-Discussion check found no matching active scope. Hosted CI is pending.

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Verified head: `2fb3301904c371c739a77e11b8937401914ab1ef`.

Prepared for aliromman with OpenAI Codex assistance. Existing tool and predecessor credits remain in place. No selected-frontier change.
